Name: Kookiefroggie's Glowing Tree Lights
Author: Kookiefroggie
Description:
First of all, a huge thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18790269]mushymato[/url] for adding support for HD TAS and lightmaps for wildtrees to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423?tab=files]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url]﻿ and helping with the code after I pitched the idea for this mod to them!

This mod adds lights to plantable wild trees in winter that actually emit light when it is dark. Currently only the pine trees get lights. The tilesheet trees would need map patches, which I might do as well. But the plantable trees enable you to easily have Glowing Tree Lights on all maps.

I just really wanted to play with this mod during the Christmas holiday myself. And I decided to already upload it, in case anyone else likes it. <3 I might add a soft twinkling animation to the lights.

A gameside limitation right now is that the lights do not fade out together with the tree when you walk behind it. Personally, it does not bother me :3

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3000?tab=posts]Crops Anytime Anywhere[/url] can be used to plant trees where it's not normally possible, to have some lights there.

[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423?tab=files]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url]﻿, you need at least version 1.12.4 or higher.
[*]Unzip this mod and place the folder "[CP] Kookiefroggie's Glowing Tree Lights" into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[/list][b][u]
Compatibility:[/u][/b]
The lights are an overlay, so they will go on top of any tree retexture you might be using.
